newsitem.title: UK: UK bookmakers cut odds on Conservative victory.
newsitem.headline: UK bookmakers cut odds on Conservative victory.

text.p: British bookmakers Ladbrokes said on Wednesday they had cut the odds on the ruling Conservatives winning the May 1 election to 4-1 from 9-2.
They lengthened the odds on Labour winning to 1-7 from 1-8. Ladbrokes said they had seen the first serious betting on the Conservatives since November 1996.

The cut in odds follows an opinion poll which showed the Labour lead cut to 14 points from 18 a month previously. But Ladbrokes said nearly all betting still focussed on how large Labour's victory margin would be.
